title: LiveSearch: Questions as Executable Verifier Code for a Live Benchmark of Professional-Source Financial Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.37166v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In finance, the answer that matters is usually the current one: prices, rates, and disclosures hold only as of a given day, so retrieving up-to-date facts is a core capability of a financial agent. Yet most financial benchmarks overlook timeliness. They fix each answer at annotation time, so the gold goes stale as markets move and, once leaked into training data, rewards recall rather than search and analysis. We introduce LiveSearch, a live benchmark that stores each question as executable verifier code: a typed program of calls to a professional financial data service, followed by a declarative extractor. The question is frozen, while its gold answer is determined by executing the program against professional financial data at evaluation time, and a daily job re-executes it with no human or language model in the loop. A memorized answer is thus likely outdated, and a model must reach the current one through tools and analysis. Construc

translated_title: LiveSearch：将问题作为可执行验证器代码的专业金融源搜索智能体实时基准
translated_abstract: 在金融领域，重要的答案通常是当前的答案：价格、利率和披露信息仅在特定日期有效，因此检索最新事实是金融智能体的核心能力。然而，大多数金融基准测试忽视了时效性。它们在标注时固定每个答案，因此随着市场变动，标准答案会过时，并且一旦泄露到训练数据中，就会奖励记忆性回忆而非搜索和分析能力。我们提出了LiveSearch，这是一个实时基准，它将每个问题存储为可执行的验证器代码：一个包含对专业金融数据服务调用的类型化程序，后跟声明式提取器。问题本身是固定的，但其标准答案是在评估时通过针对专业金融数据执行该程序来确定的，并且每日任务会自动重新执行该程序，全程无需人工或语言模型参与。因此，记忆的答案很可能已经过时，模型必须通过工具和分析来获得当前答案。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: LiveSearch提出了一种金融搜索智能体的实时基准，将问题存储为可执行的验证器代码，在评估时通过执行程序对专业金融数据动态确定标准答案，从而检验模型检索最新金融事实的能力而非记忆过时答案的能力。
